soldier: Head light yellowish brown, mandibles purplish brown, pronotum paler than the head, pilosity of the head capsule sparse. Head capsule rectangular, head-width index 0.61–0.64, lateral margins slightly widening posteriorly, posterior margin broad and rounded. Frontal surface flat, only slightly depressed between the two peaks. Labrum broadly lanceolate, its apex extending forward to before the mid-point of the mandibles, narrow, rounded and semi-transparent at the tip; apical, subapical and lateral apical setae short and slender. Mandibular apex slightly curved, mandibular basal ridge visible; left mandible about 0.83–0.87 times head width. Antennae 16 segments, the fourth the shortest. Postmentum widest at the anterior fifth, 6.75–7.35 times as long as the waist constriction; head width 5.9–6.4 times the waist constriction. Anterior margin of the pronotum with a broad forked incision, posterior margin almost straight in the middle, median emargination index about 12%; more than 20 setae in the middle region.
